title: A blind sh plume pilot has limited same-Currier and held-out hand support
statement: I froze 53 eligible ZL paragraph words before looking up locations in Ryan Allen's separate glyph map. It returned 26 exact aligned crops and one additional anchored crop. Two readers independently rated randomized, source-masked panels. They agreed on 15 of the 16 jointly definite plume-to-bench contact readings and left two targets unresolved in common. They agreed on 13 of 13 jointly definite visual spacing calls, all in the open category under the chosen rubric, and rated both rows similar in body height throughout. Fifteen exact crops had an agreed contact judgment and measurable relative line spacing. The median relative gap was 0.785 for seven contacting plumes and 0.811 for eight detached plumes. A ridge logistic pilot holding out entire physical bifolios scored both models on 11 words from 11 bifolios. Mean log loss changed from 0.670 to 0.659 when adding existing hand labels. Four other words had hand categories absent from their training folds. The scored holdouts only represent hands 1 and 2, and the same-Currier B Herbal hand-2 condition supplied no usable geometry. The sample does not establish a spacing or hand effect.
check: Build an independent roster with enough same-Currier B Herbal hand-2 and hand-5 words and extra B hand-2 Herbal and Bathing cases, selecting the candidate lines before checking map coverage. Recover failed locations in raw scans by two independently verified neighboring word anchors. Preserve unresolved contact decisions. Where multiple physical bifolios support each represented category, compare the frozen spacing-and-position classifier with the same classifier plus the existing hand label. Report support by bifolio and a matched sensitivity that sets the gap contrast above or below the target.

sources.coordinate_credits: Ryan Allen, Voynich glyph map, ryanallen.com/voynich. CC BY 4.0; Voynichese word boxes Apache 2.0; ZL 3b CC0.

methods: Draw a fixed roster from the official public ZL training pages with seed 390141 before joining coordinates. Use certain words with one EVA-basic sh in paragraph lines of at least four words. Draw up to ten per predefined cohort, at most one per line, two per page side and three per physical leaf. Shortfalls stay in the data.

Use exact Allen locus, one-based index and EVA string matching for the primary analysis. For an additional audit, allow a unique exact reading between independently matched neighboring anchors or one plausible gap between immediately adjacent exact anchors. Missing and duplicate locations are retained as failures. Use native Yale IIIF regions, not existing glyph tracings or Timm's crop locations.

Render the target at left and the neighborhood at right with an underline identifying its location. The two independently shuffled decks and the identical rubric contain no folio or hand labels. Raters record contact, visible spacing and neighboring body similarity and can choose unknown. Consensus contact requires the same definite call from both readers.

In coordinate geometry, use same-image boxes for up to three nearest words per line within 550 native pixels of the target horizontal center, excluding the target. Compute the median neighboring-word rectangle center on the current line and on each adjacent numbered paragraph line. Record positive center-to-center gaps no greater than six times the median current line neighbor rectangle height. Use the smaller available gap divided by that median height as the continuous predictor. The qualitative rubric instead compares visible neighboring row distance with ordinary body height and is not numerically equivalent.

With only exact locations, definite agreed contact and available geometry, compare a ridge logistic model on log relative gap, word position on the line, sh position within the word, Currier group and illustration section, with the same model plus existing hand. Recompute scaling inside each fold and exclude all words on the held-out physical bifolio. Compare paired log losses only for test words whose section, Currier and hand appear in training with both contact classes present. This is a small public pilot; fixed map coverage and confounded hand/section support limit interpretation.

frozen_rubric:
Read only the letterforms and layout in the numbered panels. Each panel gives a close word at left and the same location in its neighboring writing at right. The thin blue underline in the context locates the target. Do not infer the source page, writer or text.

Record three independent judgments for every identifier, including uncertain ones:

1. Contact. Find the single EVA sh if visible, a bench-like joined pair of curves with a small raised plume. Record C for a visible continuous connection of ink from that plume to its own bench, D for a clear parchment gap, and ? if the shapes overlap other strokes, the apparent connection is too faint, or you cannot locate a unique target. Do not infer pen motion.
2. Spacing. In the context use the nearest neighboring row with text overlapping the target's horizontal span. Compare the baseline-to-baseline distance with approximately twice the height of the ordinary word bodies immediately around the target, excluding the target and tall ascenders. Record T when the distance is visibly below twice the body height, O when visibly above, and ? when the side is truncated or too close to call.
3. Body height. In the same region compare the current row's ordinary bodies with the adjacent row's. Record S when similar, V when one is visibly taller by roughly a quarter or more, and ? when either row cannot be judged.

Output a row "ID Contact Spacing Height" for each card. An optional short note is welcome after the four fields, particularly when contact is indeterminate.

reproduction.environment: Python 3.12.14, NumPy 2.3.5, Pillow and the repository's pinned public material.

code.freeze_roster.py:
"""Freeze an independent candidate roster from public ZL paragraph words."""

from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path
import random
import re

from vs import corpus, ivtff


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
QUOTA = 10
SEED = 390141
COHORTS = [("A", "1", "H"), ("A", "1", "P"), ("B", "2", "H"), ("B", "2", "B"), ("B", "3", "H"), ("B", "5", "H")]


def candidate(page, line, index):
    return {
        "page": page.id,
        "leaf": re.match(r"f\d+", page.id)[0],
        "line": line.n,
        "word_index": index,
        "word": line.words[index - 1],
        "words_on_line": len(line.words),
        "currier": page.language,
        "hand": str(page.hand),
        "section": page.section,
        "bifolio": f"{page.meta.get('Q','?')}{page.meta.get('B','?')}",
        "paragraph_opener": line.para_start,
        "paragraph_closer": line.para_end,
    }


def main():
    training, _ = corpus.split_pages("practice", "zl")
    frame = defaultdict(list)
    for page in training:
        cohort = (page.language, str(page.hand), page.section)
        if cohort not in COHORTS:
            continue
        for line in page.lines:
            if line.unit != "P" or len(line.words) < 4:
                continue
            for index, word in enumerate(line.words, 1):
                units = ivtff.segment(word, "eva-basic")
                if "?" not in word and "*" not in word and units.count("sh") == 1:
                    frame[cohort].append(candidate(page, line, index))
    rng = random.Random(SEED)
    roster = []
    summary = []
    for cohort in COHORTS:
        eligible = list(frame[cohort])
        rng.shuffle(eligible)
        selected = []
        seen_lines = set()
        page_counts = Counter()
        leaf_counts = Counter()
        for item in eligible:
            line_key = (item["page"], item["line"])
            if line_key in seen_lines or page_counts[item["page"]] == 2 or leaf_counts[item["leaf"]] == 3:
                continue
            selected.append(item)
            seen_lines.add(line_key)
            page_counts[item["page"]] += 1
            leaf_counts[item["leaf"]] += 1
            if len(selected) == QUOTA:
                break
        roster.extend(selected)
        summary.append({"cohort": cohort, "eligible": len(eligible),
                        "eligible_pages": len({item["page"] for item in eligible}),
                        "eligible_bifolios": len({item["bifolio"] for item in eligible}),
                        "selected": len(selected), "selected_leaves": len(leaf_counts)})
    content = {"seed": SEED, "quota": QUOTA, "cohorts": summary, "entries": roster}
    file = ROOT / "frozen-roster.json"
    file.write_text(json.dumps(content, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({"rows": len(roster), "sha256": sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "cohorts": summary}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
